name: ADAM
canonical: Adam, the first man, a strong athletic young figure with warm sun-bronzed skin, tousled dark-brown hair and a short dark beard, a noble face now stricken with shame and eyes cast down, his bare muscular body covered only by a rough girdle of sewn green fig leaves about his loins, crouching half-hidden among the lush trees of Eden
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
